Introduction

Double 0ne is an 11-member project boy group under PocketDol Studio. They consist of BAE173's Yoojun, Muzin, Junseo, Youngseo, Doha, and Bit and FANTASY BOYS's Kang Minseo, Lee Hanbin, Hikari, Ling Qi, and Hong Sungmin. They made their debut on June 12, 2025 with the single "On the Rocks with Kiss."
